name: spec-to-code-compliance
description: Holds code to what its documents promise: extracts each requirement from READMEs, design notes, OpenAPI, argument_specs, Terraform variable descriptions, CI input text and help output, checks every one with a dedicated agent, has two more agents try to knock down each divergence, and writes a per-requirement verdict report with severity to $TMPDIR. Read-only; never runs the code.
